fix(renderer): clarify custom mount target default

## Problem

When **Custom Paths** is selected in the workspace wizard, the form claims an empty **Target path in workspace** defaults to the host path. It actually targets `/sandbox/<folder name>` inside the sandbox, so the host path (`/Users/me/project-data`) is not available there.

## Fix

Reword the hint to describe the real behavior, from one shared string used by both the hint and the placeholder:

- only the sandbox working directory and `/tmp` are writable by default;
- an empty target places the folder at `/sandbox/<folder name>`.

The hint says "place" rather than "mount" because a gateway without bind mounts uploads the folder to that path instead of bind mounting it.

`AgentWorkspaceCreate.spec.ts` asserts the whole hint rather than a substring, and the stale "defaults target to host path" test name is corrected.

Fixes #3267

## Review follow-up

- **Where the writable-paths sentence comes from.** Kaiden passes no filesystem policy of its own, so sandboxes run on OpenShell's default policy: the working directory is read-write, `/tmp` and `/dev/null` too — see the [OpenShell default policy reference](https://docs.nvidia.com/openshell/how-it-works/policies/default-policy) and `FilesystemPolicy.includeWorkdir` ("Automatically include the workdir as read-write") in `@nvidia/openshell-sdk`. The in-repo rationale for the `/sandbox` default target is 1081bed1, whose message states that OpenShell sandboxes only allow writes under `/sandbox` and `/tmp`.
- **Mount behavior is unchanged on purpose.** `/sandbox/<folder name>` is the expected behavior for an empty target, per the [issue owner's comment on #3267](https://github.com/openkaiden/kaiden/issues/3267): "it's actually expected as only /sandbox/ and /tmp/ are writeable. The fix is to reword the description." The hint was the wrong part.
- **Native Windows host paths (CodeRabbit, major).** Valid finding, but fixing it changes the derived mount target, so it is split out to #3272: `buildMountsFrom` and `buildMountsFromSelection` split the host path only on `/`, so `C:\Users\alice\configs` stays whole. This PR is now limited to the wording.
- **`/sandbox` is still duplicated in the renderer, accepted for this fix.** `openshell-mounts.ts:32` and `WORKSPACE_SOURCES_PATH` in the claude/codex extensions own the base, and the renderer only renders copy. The literal was already in this component before the PR (placeholder) and in the hint; the change merges the two copies into one constant. Removing the duplication means having main expose the resolved mount base over IPC, which is an API change and can be a follow-up.
- **Custom images.** A container image whose `WORKDIR` is not `/sandbox` gets an unusable default target. That is a separate behavior issue, tracked in #3271.

## Screenshots

### Before

![Custom Paths mount hint before the fix](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/db3f3466-dc63-4879-9cbb-3d4cbf28af6c)

### After

![Custom Paths mount hint after the fix](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/79c4ae5d-743a-4f38-b851-e8d0970308bb)

> The "After" screenshot still shows the earlier wording ("mount the folder at"); the text now reads "place the folder at" so it also holds when a gateway uploads instead of bind mounting.

:bug:(database): widen the market data ids to BIGINT UNSIGNED

Titre : :bug:(database): widen the market data ids to BIGINT UNSIGNED

## Description
`id` de `market_candles`, `market_trades`, `market_tickers` passe de `INT` à `BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT` (migration `010_widen_market_data_ids`). Les upserts consomment une valeur d'auto-incrément par ligne proposée, même existante : l'INT signé s'épuisait en 1 à 3 ans avec 20-40 symboles.

- Expand only, N-1 compatible (id lu comme nombre, `supportBigNumbers: true`). Aucune migration appliquée modifiée.
- `down` : `MODIFY … INT`; en mode strict MySQL refuse (« Out of range value ») si un id dépasse 2147483647, aucune troncature.
- Types TS (`NumberValueSource`) inchangés : valeurs < 2^53 restent des nombres, JSON des routes inchangé.
- Pas de dépendance ajoutée à `db-migrate`.

## Related Issues
Closes #1379

## Plan de test
- `bun run lint` : pass
- `bun run --filter financial-scraper test` : 437 passed
- `bun run adr:check` : OK
- Cas `test:db` ajouté (`AUTO_INCREMENT = 2147483648` puis upsert de trade, id > 2^31-1).
- **Non vérifié localement** : `test:db` (Testcontainers MySQL : « Port 3306/tcp not bound after 120000ms », disque Docker lent), donc à confirmer par la CI. `api:check` non relancé (aucune route touchée). Le `down` n'est pas testé (comportement strict-mode MySQL).
- `build:ts` non lancé séparément (aucun code source modifié; `bun run build` des paquets lancé).

Simplification : rien à simplifier.
Taille : +27 / −0 (budget 200)

Conversor: o coro do final vai para a última estrofe (+ registro do zip 013)

Continuação da #24, cujo merge pegou só até o f2e3a18; estes 2 commits chegaram depois.

## Coro do final na última estrofe
No hino 457 (com final) o hinário impresso traz o coro **depois da última estrofe**, mas o autor o escreveu no `.mscx` sob a estrofe 1, e o conversor o deixava lá. Agora, num hino com final reconhecido, o texto que começa na 2ª casa e está sob uma estrofe que **não é a última** passa para a última (`coro_para_a_ultima_estrofe`). Só quando esse texto está todo sob **uma única** estrofe; com mais de uma, fica como o autor escreveu. No hino 398 (coro logo depois da estrofe 1, sem final) nada muda.

- O karaokê não muda: o app só acende o coro na última vez, e ele já era acendido lá (`marcasDaVez`).
- 5 testes novos com texto **fictício** (4 da função e 1 do conversor de ponta a ponta com um hino fictício com final), verificados por mutação (sem a chamada no `converter`, o de ponta a ponta falha; sem a guarda de estrofe única, o de várias estrofes falha). `cargo fmt --check`, `clippy -D warnings` e `cargo test` (63).
- `docs/FORMATO.md` e I-19 atualizados. Nenhum trecho de hino real no diff.

## Registro do zip de teste 013
Linha 013 em `docs/apk-de-teste.md` (letra por verso; app igual ao 012, muda o conteúdo embutido). Esse zip foi gerado antes do ajuste do coro: o conteúdo do **014** já sairá com ele.

## Limite
O coro continua sem marca no JSON (negrito e separação do impresso): I-19.

fix(tooling): use own-key records in verification guards

Build migration catalog snapshots, SQL performance counts and network-budget records through map accumulators, then materialize records at their existing output boundaries. Resolve lint-plugin aliases through own properties. Remove six computed-record findings while preserving sequential table queries, enum label order, SQL/network budgets and ratchet allowances.

The alias test declares its in-memory fixtures and static import closure so the existing test selector includes subject changes and skips unrelated changes. It does not invoke the filesystem-backed catalog.

Validation: 82 owning tests and 388 assertions passed; the prior alias lookup fails four regression cases. The selector/alias checks pass 84 tests. Guard source and owning tests are unchanged by integration with the merged permission-feedback correction in #8669. Normal commit/push hooks pass; CI validates the integrated head and broader checks.
